notes.title: Update: controller support
notes.content:
New feature – Added controller support!

Now you can fight bosses comfortably leaning back in your chair!

The backgrounds and illustrations have also been updated, and mouse errors have been fixed.

If you have any problems, we will be glad to hear about them in the comments!

tags.bug: and mouse errors have been fixed.

notes.title: Mac version and other updates
notes.content:
New - Mac version added!

Bug fixes:
- Fixed softlocks in combat
- Speed up combat by changing bot behavior
- Bot no longer uses spells to defeat itself
- Fixed voice and sound playback issues in combat
- Fixed interface display issues on non-standard resolutions
- Minor visual bug fixes
